truths.truth: install.sh refuses a SHA-256 mismatch, an unsupported uname -s, an unsupported uname -m and an http:// source, and leaves the stable path and the versions folder byte-identical
truths.evidence: install.sh:109 refuses a source not starting with https://; :140-149 map uname -s Linux/Darwin and uname -m x86_64/aarch64/arm64 and fail otherwise; verify_download (:71-75) is called at :191, before the first write at :195-210. Tests a_digest_that_does_not_match_is_refused, an_unsupported_system_is_refused (fake uname FreeBSD), an_unsupported_architecture_is_refused (Linux/riscv64) and an_http_source_is_refused (crates/terminus/tests/install_script.rs:600-637) each start from a completed install and call assert_refused (:441-449), which compares a snapshot of the stable path's entry, every entry and inode under the versions folder, settings.json and .claude.json, and asserts a non-zero exit, non-empty stderr and no new claude call. All four reported ok in the one full-suite run (cargo test --workspace --all-features: 784 passed, 0 failed, exit 0).

truths.truth: Installing version A and then version B links the stable path to B, leaves A's file with the same bytes and inode, and a terminus mcp started through the link before B keeps running from A's file
truths.evidence: Test successive_installs_keep_every_version (crates/terminus/tests/install_script.rs:702-727) installs 1.0.0, starts <stable> mcp with stdin held open, installs 2.0.0, then asserts the link targets versions/2.0.0/terminus with the served bytes, versions/1.0.0/terminus has the same bytes and inode, the mcp process is still running, and read_link(/proc/<pid>/exe) equals the canonical path of A's file. The /proc block is cfg(target_os = "linux") and ran on this Linux machine. Reported ok in the full-suite run. Seam trace: the manifest's version string "2.0.0" enters through the served manifest, is parsed at install.sh:175-179, and lands as read_link(stable) == versions/2.0.0/terminus in assert_linked.

truths.truth: One install.sh run with a fake claude that succeeds exits 0, merges the four hook entries naming the stable path and logs claude mcp add-json --scope user terminus; with no claude on PATH it exits non-zero after the receipt's install incomplete line
truths.evidence: install.sh:232 ends with "$stable" install, so its status is the script's (set -eu at :6). crates/terminus/src/cmd/install/mod.rs:154 prints "install incomplete: the mcp server is not registered" and :237 returns Failure::Silent. Test one_run_installs_and_wires_claude_code (install_script.rs:521-553) asserts exit 0, the link to versions/1.0.0/terminus holding the served bytes, exactly one hook entry per event in SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, SessionEnd and PostCompact whose command is the stable path, and one logged add-json call with args mcp add-json --scope user terminus, command the stable path and args ["mcp"]. Test no_claude_exits_non_zero_after_the_link_is_placed (:557-571) asserts a non-zero exit, the install incomplete line on stdout, and the link still placed. Both ok in the full-suite run. Seam trace: HOME enters as the script's environment, install.sh builds $stable from it (:135-137), and terminus install's stable_path() (binary.rs:79-99) resolves the same path, which lands as the hook entries' command and the add-json entry's command.

truths.truth: A file without the marker at the stable path is refused by both install.sh and terminus install with the file unchanged, and a plain file carrying the marker is replaced by the link into the versions folder
truths.evidence: install.sh:91-93 accepts a regular file only when grep -q -F finds the marker. crates/terminus/src/cmd/install/mod.rs:119-121 refuses a Foreign occupant before versions_dir, config and settings are read and before place at :137, and binary.rs:281-282 asks occupant again just before the rename. Tests: a_file_without_the_marker_is_refused (install_script.rs:652-659, snapshot unchanged including the file's bytes), a_foreign_binary_at_the_stable_path_stops_everything (crates/terminus/tests/install.rs:522-560: non-zero exit, file bytes unchanged, no versions folder, settings and .claude.json unchanged, no claude call), a_marked_plain_file_is_replaced_by_the_link (install_script.rs:752-760) and a_marked_plain_file_at_the_stable_path_becomes_the_link (install.rs:454-470). All ok in the full-suite run. The script's marker copy (install.sh:12) is tied to binary::MARKER by install_sh_holds_the_same_marker (binary.rs:401-411), which reported ok.

truths.truth: terminus install run from a build stores it at versions/<its version>/terminus behind the link, a rebuild at the same version with different bytes replaces that file, and install run through the stable path keeps the link and the version file's inodes and the link's target
truths.evidence: binary.rs:197-208 (place) stores current_exe() under env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION") and links to it unless linked_to (:218-232) finds the link's target, directly under the versions folder, to be the same device and inode as current_exe(); store (:239-266) leaves same bytes alone and otherwise renames a temporary over the file; link (:275-292) renames a temporary link over the stable path. Called from mod.rs:137. Tests: install_places_this_build_at_the_stable_path (install.rs:393-450: symlink, read_link == versions/<CARGO_PKG_VERSION>/terminus, bytes equal the build, mode has 0o111, hooks and add-json name the stable path and never the version file, receipt names the version file); a_rebuild_at_the_same_version_replaces_its_file_and_a_rerun_does_not (:474-518); install_from_the_stable_path_touches_neither_the_link_nor_the_file (:1399-1423); install_through_a_link_to_another_version_folder_leaves_it_alone (:1428-1450). All ok in the full-suite run. The tests run cargo's debug build (CARGO_BIN_EXE_terminus) rather than target/release/terminus; binary.rs has no profile-dependent code, so it is the same path.

gaps.name: terminus uninstall leaves a dangling link into the versions folder at the stable path and says nothing is there
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - unplace treats a dangling link as Vacant, so the link this phase's own layout leaves behind once the versions folder is gone is never removed, and the report line is false
gaps.evidence: crates/terminus/src/cmd/uninstall.rs:366-372: unplace asks binary::occupant, which uses File::open (crates/terminus/src/cmd/install/binary.rs:145-148), and a link to nothing is NotFound, so Vacant, so it prints "not there: nothing to remove" and returns. Observed: with ~/.local/bin/terminus a dangling link to versions/0.1.1/terminus in a scratch HOME, terminus uninstall exited 0, printed that line, and the link was still there. This state is real: install.sh:78-79 and DESIGN-BRIEF.md:398 describe it as what is left after the versions folder is deleted, and DESIGN-BRIEF.md:400 says uninstall removes the link. CONTEXT D-05 says unplace inherits the Vacant rule for a dangling link, so fixing this narrows D-05 for uninstall and is the owner's call.
gaps.missing: In unplace, when symlink_metadata shows a symbolic link and occupant is Vacant, remove it if read_link gives <versions>/<one folder>/terminus (install.sh's check_stable_path rule, install.sh:83-90), and otherwise leave it and say a link to nothing outside the versions folder is there, not "not there". unplace needs the versions path passed in. Add a test in crates/terminus/tests/uninstall.rs that deletes the versions folder after an install, runs uninstall, and asserts symlink_metadata(stable) is NotFound.
